mobbin:8c74a0f5-c330-413e-96c1-59a8487cd.summary: From Home the user opens an empty Shopping List, then after recipes are added reviews per-recipe “N out of N missing,” expands ingredients with a servings stepper, and ticks items on All items until some are struck through as already-have.
steps: Home — Editor’s Choice + Shopping list tab
Recipe detail — servings stepper + unchecked ingredients
All items — mixed checked / unchecked + Unmark all
steal: Per-scenario “14 out of 14 items missing” under each recipe (steps 2–3) — shortage headline before opening the list.
Recipes vs All items tabs (steps 2–5) — group by scenario or flatten for a shopping/prep run.
Servings stepper scales quantities (step 3) — learner-count or repeat-run multiplier for consumables.
Checkbox → strikethrough + Unmark all (steps 4–5) — mark already-on-shelf and reset for the next session.
avoid: Matching is manual tick-only (steps 3–5); no auto-compare against a pantry/shelf — Baseline wants AI/shelf match, not only hand checks.
mobbin:8c74a0f5-c330-413e-96c1-59a8487cd.fit: Extends Baseline ai-equipment + shortage UX: recipe = scenario equipment list; missing counts and unchecked rows = shelf gaps; checked = already have — not auto inventory deduct.
